method: Counterfactual component-wise clipping of recorded target_joint_pos, already clipped to model/controller limits, against exact local class-driver bounds. No dynamics replay or retraining.
scored_mask: Existing trace valid mask; excludes warmup and reset/failure transitions according to original evaluator.
coordinate_evidence: Named ROS joint coordinates after SPI sign/offset conversion and subtraction of homing zero. Normal hardware write calls copy_actuator_commands(true); it clamps cmd_pos to these limits when kp>0, then adds the homing zero before the SPI sign/offset transform. Thus these limits apply in the same joint coordinates as policy target_joint_pos, not raw motor coordinates.

conclusion: Second-clamp incidence is material. Existing controller-clamp experiments remain valid under their recorded simulation contract, but cannot establish exact physical command parity. Performance under the extra driver clamp requires a separately named dynamics evaluation before deciding whether further training is necessary.
limitations: Does not model motor current/torque sensing, latency, velocity/feedforward clamp, friction, thermal limits or installed calibration.
Driver position clamp applies when kp>0 and normal write(true), as in the local neural position-control configuration.
Installed Pi descriptions/driver/firmware may differ; local source bounds are explicitly not asserted to be installed hardware limits.
